newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes stronger on corporate buying.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes stronger on corporate buying.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed stronger on Monday at C$1.3463 (US$0.7428) from Friday's close of C$1.3485 (US$0.7416).
* Dealers said strong U.S. corporate interest to buy the currency dominated the market in morning trading, giving the unit its strength.
* They said C$1.3450 will be a technical barrier this week.
Dealers said C$1.3450 was a key technical level that would be tough to break.
Market players feel the Bank of Canada will move to cut interest rates again if the Canadian currency strengthens beyond that level, dealers said.
Weak retail sales data released Monday fuelled the speculation about rates. Canadian August retail sales fell 0.4 percent, seasonally adjusted, from the month before.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar slipped to 1.1390 marks from Friday's 1.1432 marks and rose to 83.64 yen from 83.38 yen.
